detect_boilerplate_document: detect boilerplate in a datatrove Document by finding common top and bottom lines across pages
apply_boilerplate_tags_page: apply docling boilerplate tags around detected boilerplate lines in a single page
find_common_lines_from_top: find common lines from the top of pages using normalized deduplication with configurable thresholds
find_common_lines_from_bottom: find common lines from the bottom of pages using normalized deduplication with configurable thresholds
run_TagBoilerplateFormatter: run the TagBoilerplateFormatter pipeline step to tag or drop boilerplate from datatrove documents
